newsitem.title: USA: Marcus to expand Woodfield Suites division.
newsitem.headline: Marcus to expand Woodfield Suites division.

text.p: Marcus Corp said Thursday it plans to expand its Woodfield Suites division and expects that 40 to 50 of the motels will be in operation within the next five years.

Marcus currently owns and operates Woodfield Suites in Appleton and Milwaukee, Wis. and in Denver. A fourth will open in Cincinnati, Ohio in early December and a fifth property in Madison, Wis. is cheduled to open next spring.

"Our strategy is to grow this division by acquiring land for new construction, acquiring and converting existing properties to the Woodfield Suites concept and introducing a franchise program in 1997," said chairman Stephen Marcus said in remarks prepared for delivery to a Chicago analysts group.
